direction: Raise anytime-LNS intensity: adaptively scale ruin-set size and iteration count to consume the full 500ms budget (prior best used only ~188ms), with greedy + regret-2 recreate and simulated-acceptance, emphasizing clustered-spatial and tight-capacity regimes.

operations.mechanism: Archive shows objective barely varies across 5 solvers (16.05–16.13) with a VBS gap of only 0.31%, meaning the template is stable but under-exploiting the time budget. The strongest solver used 188ms and best objective; round5 regressed while using only 123ms. Filling the 500ms budget with adaptive ruin size (larger ruptures on tight-capacity/clustered instances, smaller on uniform-demand) plus SISR-style acceptance should trade negligible extra time for measurable objective reduction without changing the validated interface.

preserve: Route feasibility, strict time budget, and scale invariance.
hypothesis: The Pareto-optimal incumbent (round3, obj 16.0504 @188ms) and round5 (16.1239 @123ms) leave substantial unused budget headroom. Scaling ruin-recreate iterations to fill ~500ms and adapting ruin size to instance clustering/capacity-tightness will lower mean objective, especially on the weakest regimes (spatial=clustered, capacity_level=tight, size=100).
